mods.author: Shinawase
mods.descriptionZh: 社区流媒体：网易云日推、相似歌曲连播、灰色歌曲解锁和歌手专辑，轻量版不含一起听与评论。
mods.descriptionEn: Community streaming: NetEase dailies, similar-track autoplay, grey-track unblock, and artist albums. Lightweight build without listen-together or comments.

mods.author: Shinawase
mods.descriptionZh: 恢复隐藏的 MV：自动搜索并尽量套用匹配视频，播放条入口加上歌词页抽屉设置。
mods.descriptionEn: Restores hidden MV: auto-search and apply a matching video, with a player-bar entry and lyrics-page settings drawer.

mods.author: Shinawase
mods.descriptionZh: 用官方标题栏「歌词设置」拉开抽屉做匹配；不再弹出挡住歌词的浮层，也不再注入角落圆图标。
mods.descriptionEn: Match lyrics from the official title-bar Lyrics settings drawer. No overlay that covers lyrics, and no extra corner icon.
